title: Electronically modulated cobalt–nitrogen/carbon catalyst via ligand displacement of metal–organic frameworks toward efficient oxygen reduction
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1755-1764
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01348D, Paper
Pengcheng Wan, Bin Li, Yihang Tang, Xu Zeng, Yulong Wu, Junlong Yao, Junwu Xiao, Bao Yu Xia, Yimin Sun
Ligand displacement in a metal–organic framework to introduce nitrogen and sulphur elements could tailor the electronic environment and oxygen binding force of the resulting cobalt–nitrogen/carbon catalyst to improve its oxygen reduction activity.
